title: Canary rollout scratchpad - v1.13.0
content:
Context:
- Target: roll out server/runtime change + model-compatibility fixes in v1.13.0. Includes kernel selector improvements, KV cache fixes for long-context sessions, and a new quantization profile (q4_0fast) for dedicated pools.
- Rollout owner: Evelyn Park (release-engineering). Backup owner: Noah Kim.
- Scope: Hosted API and Dedicated staging pools. Private customer deployments not included in this canary.

Goals / success criteria:
- No increase in 99th latency by >15% on P50->P99 buckets for generation endpoints (seq_len 512 typical).
- Error rate (5xx) <= 0.5% on canary traffic window.
- Token cost/unit within expected +-5% vs baseline (monitor per-route token accounting).
- No regression on structured output tests (see linked evals in Confluence).

High level plan (rough timeline):
- Prep (T-2d): finalize feature flags, pinning config, rollback steps, update runbooks. Notify CS/infra.
- Day 0 morning: deploy v1.13.0 to canary infra (1% traffic). 30-60m observation.
- Day 0 midday: if green -> increase to 5% for 2h.
- Day 0 evening: if green -> increase to 20% for 4h.
- Day 1: 50% for 6h.
- Day 2: 100% if stable.
- Fast rollback at any stage if thresholds crossed.

Checklist (execute & tick off):
- [ ] Merge infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/879 (done)
- [ ] Confirm canary config in TrafficRouter: feature_flag: rollout_v1_13 = on (scope: hosted-api, dedicated-canary)
- [ ] Create canary monitoring dashboard (copy of prod gen dashboard) and add anomaly alerts
- [ ] Update pinned model variants list (see pinning_notes below)
- [ ] Run smoke tests against staging after deploy (smoke-suite/generate-basic)
- [ ] Notify on-call: #oncall-release + slack DM to SRE lead
- [ ] Post-deploy evaluations: run structured-output-checklist (see Confluence page)

Pinning notes / compatibility:
- Default model: redwood/open-llama-13b:v2 -> keep pinned to v2 until canary passes.
- For fallback routing, ensure older quantized variant exists: redwood/open-llama-13b:q4_0 -> set as fallback in routing policy.
- Dedicated pools: attach new quant profile q4_0fast only to dedicated-canary pool (do NOT enable global).
- Prompt templates: check that client-side truncation still valid for kv-cache changes (esp chat contexts > 4k).

Monitoring + alerts (immediate triggers):
- Alert A (Critical): 5xx error rate > 0.5% over 10m window on canary traffic -> PAUSE rollout, rollback to previous revision.
- Alert B (High): P99 latency increase > 25% vs baseline over 15m -> pause and investigate.
- Alert C (Medium): Cost per token delta > +10% -> alert release owner and infra (may pause).
- Logs to check: model-serving logs (cors, OOMs), kernel selection warnings, kv-cache eviction events.
- Dashboards: /dashboards/canary-gen, /dashboards/canary-cost, /dashboards/canary-errors

Rollback procedure (fast):
1) Set feature_flag rollout_v1_13 = off (TrafficRouter) to stop new canary allocations.
2) Scale down canary deployment and scale up previous revision (v1.12.x) in same pools: kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=<v1.12-rev>
3) If routing change needed: run traffic-router revert command: traffic-router apply --policy canary-revert-v1-12
4) Invalidate problematic caches if required: redis-cli -h <host> FLUSHDB <if instructed> (run with caution)
5) Postmortem: collect logs, core dumps, kernel warnings, and open RL-4571-rollback for tracking.

Smoke commands (quick):
- Health: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" https://canary.api.redwood.ai/health
- Small gen: curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"open-llama-13b:v2","prompt":"hello"}' | jq .
- Check pods: kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=inference-runtime -o wide

Open questions / TODOs:
- Do we want to enable q4_0fast in any non-dedicated pool during canary? my recommendation: NO until we validate output regression tests.
- Confirm whether private deployments need a separate advisory (cc: Priya for legal/compliance message).
- Need SRE to verify kernel selection logs are surfaced to the centralized log (ticket created).
- Confirm exact production baseline numbers for P99 latency (ask observability team for snapshot).

Notes from today's pre-run (11/03):
- Observed slight increase in tail latency for seq_len>1024 in synthetic microbenchmarks; looks related to kv-cache warmup. Added a 15m warmup window at each scale step.
- One test run showed a small mismatch in structured output (field ordering) when using q4_0fast; added structured-output-checklist to post-deploy evals.

Contacts:
- Release owner: Evelyn Park (evelyn.park@redwood.ai)
- Backup owner: Noah Kim (noah.kim@redwood.ai)
- SRE lead: Priya Kapoor (priya.kapoor@redwood.ai)

Quick links:
- Confluence rollout plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RL/v1.13+rollout+plan
- Jira RL-4571 (tracking): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RL-4571
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/879

End notes: keep this doc as the single-source scratchpad for the run (I'll update timestamps as we progress). If anything unexpected, call the rollback and start forensic.
